description: This file defines classes and enums related to managing WebChat UI components in a macOS application, including a custom panel class and a singleton manager class for handling chat sessions and UI presentation.

classes.name: WebChatPanel
classes.description: A borderless NSPanel subclass that can accept key focus for typing.

classes.name: WebChatManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing WebChat sessions and UI presentation (window or panel).

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a chat session in a window identified by sessionKey.

methods.name: togglePanel
methods.description: Toggles the display of a chat panel anchored to a specific location.

methods.name: closePanel
methods.description: Closes the open chat panel, if any.

methods.name: preferredSessionKey
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred session key asynchronously, using cached value or fetching via GatewayConnection.

methods.name: resetTunnels
methods.description: Resets and closes all open chat windows and panels, clearing cached session keys.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all chat sessions and UI components.

methods.name: panelHidden
methods.description: Handles actions when the panel is hidden, specifically triggering visibility change callback.
